intent_en: To demonstrate that nuclear power generates a larger share of global electricity than solar energy.
narration_support: Nuclear power generates around 10 .6 % of the electricity used around the world, while solar energy supplies less than 6 .3%. In this regard, nuclear energy is the clear winner.
chart_support: Side-by-side comparison graphic showing electricity generated percentages for nuclear power (cooling towers) and solar energy (panels), with the nuclear value being higher.
evidence_note: The narration explicitly compares the two energy sources and declares nuclear the winner, while the chart visually reinforces this with higher percentage labels for nuclear power (10.6%) versus solar (6.3%).
